name: repo-harness-tuner
description: Harness Tuner helps Codex choose the next safe repo step, draft project roadmaps, tune repo harnesses, and recommend minimal adapter skills with approval gates.

interface.shortDescription: Ask Harness Tuner for read-only next steps, roadmaps, and approval boundaries.
interface.longDescription: Harness Tuner is a Codex workspace tuner for natural-language project direction. Its purpose is not to make Codex silently do everything; it keeps the repo-local working contract clear: what Codex may handle, what it may inspect or change, what counts as done, and when a human must approve. In a repo context, prompts like “Harness Tuner로 이 repo에서 다음에 뭐할지 읽기 전용으로 안내해줘”, “Harness Tuner로 로드맵 작성해줘”, or “Use Harness Tuner to draft a roadmap for this repo” should start with a read-only planning pass: inspect the repo, label the work type, draft phases/milestones/priorities/validation/approval points, show approval boundaries, and suggest validation. A bare chat message like “next” is ambiguous and should not launch apps, browsers, UI tests, builds, hardware checks, file writes, installs, or domain-specific implementation skills before the read-only Harness Tuner summary. Roadmap requests should draft in chat by default; creating or updating ROADMAP.md, Docs/AI/*, issues, tasks, release notes, or milestone files requires explicit approval. It helps Codex keep planning, development support, review, harness tuning, history, and minimal skill recommendations organized as a project evolves. It writes files, changes repo policy, installs adapter skills, or touches release/deploy/dependency-sensitive areas only after explicit approval. It includes codex-harness-setup for repo-local AGENTS.md and Docs/AI/* harness setup, release-check for fresh-copy validation, fixture tests for regression coverage, and recommendation-only ECC seed catalog support without bulk installing external hooks, MCP servers, slash commands, native agents, marketplace entries, or policy changes.
capabilities: Codex team and skill factory planning
Repo-local agent and skill artifact generation
Continuous skill curator from history and eval evidence
Closed-loop diagnosis from eval and history
defaultPrompt: Use $repo-harness-tuner to inspect this repo read-only and tell me the next safe step. Do not open apps, run tests, write files, or install anything; show preview/apply boundaries.
Use $repo-harness-tuner to draft a roadmap for this repo from read-only evidence. Do not write ROADMAP.md unless I approve it.
Use $repo-harness-tuner to plan the next milestone, release plan, and development sequence from read-only evidence.
Harness Tuner로 이 repo에서 다음에 뭐할지 읽기 전용으로 안내해줘. 창 열기, 테스트 실행, 파일 쓰기, 설치는 하지 말고 preview/apply 경계만 보여줘.
Harness Tuner로 이 repo 로드맵 초안을 작성해줘. ROADMAP.md 저장은 내가 승인하기 전에는 하지 마.
Use Harness Tuner to plan this project read-only first, then list what needs approval before any implementation.
Use Harness Tuner to define scope, access/actions, definition of done, and human approval points for this repo.
Use Harness Tuner to review the validation loop for this repo without running tests yet.
Use Harness Tuner to recommend minimal skills or agents for this repo, but do not install anything.
